module.name: Hypertension
module.description: Example module file with observations. The blood pressure ranges are Synthea's own configuration (src/main/resources/biometrics.yml, metabolic.blood_pressure.normal), not a clinical norm: BloodPressureValueGenerator draws a baseline from them and then adds medication, lifestyle and a 12-hour variation, so recorded values can fall outside them. The file gives no expected prevalence or incidence.
